title: Lockless Circular Ring Buffer with TypedArrays
concept: Ring Buffer Head/Tail Pointers & Modulo Addressing
problemStatement: Implement `createCircularBuffer(capacity)` that manages a fixed-size byte buffer. Methods: `write(byte)` (returns false if full), `read()` (returns byte or null if empty), `isFull()`, and `isEmpty()`.
interviewTrap: In shared-memory multi-threaded Web Worker architectures, circular buffers prevent lock contention between audio/compute threads and the UI thread.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: An ArrayBuffer is a contiguous chunk of raw heap memory. TypedArrays (Uint8Array, Int32Array) and DataViews provide structured lenses over the buffer. Endianness matters when parsing multi-byte integers across platforms.

interviewCrossQuestions.question: How does a Circular Ring Buffer achieve lockless O(1) reads and writes?
interviewCrossQuestions.answer: A Ring Buffer uses a fixed-size TypedArray with two integer pointers: `head` (read index) and `tail` (write index). Pointers advance using modulo arithmetic (`(tail + 1) % capacity`). In single-producer single-consumer scenarios, writes and reads never contend for the same memory slot, operating in lockless O(1) time without garbage collection.
interviewCrossQuestions.whyAsked: Classic systems engineering data structure question.

realWorldUseCases.description: Streaming audio PCM chunks from the main thread to an AudioWorkletProcessor thread via a SharedArrayBuffer ring buffer.

howToExplain.opening: A circular ring buffer uses a fixed-size typed array and wrapping pointers to provide a lockless, zero-allocation FIFO queue.
keyPoints: Fixed-size array eliminates dynamic memory allocation and GC churn.
Modulo arithmetic wraps head and tail pointers seamlessly.
Distinguishes full from empty states by tracking element count.
Ideal for real-time audio processing and high-frequency message streams.
howToExplain.closingImpression: Ring buffers provide deterministic latency by eliminating memory re-allocation in critical audio and networking paths.
analogies: A sushi conveyor belt: the chef places plates at the tail, customers pick plates from the head; the belt loops in a circle without needing to expand.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing an empty buffer with a full buffer when head === tail.
commonMistakes.why: When head === tail, the buffer could be either 100% empty or 100% full.
commonMistakes.correct: Maintain an explicit `count` variable, or leave one slot empty as a guard.

followUpDeepDive.question: How do Atomics and SharedArrayBuffer enable multi-threaded ring buffers in Web Workers?
followUpDeepDive.answer: `SharedArrayBuffer` allows two threads to share memory. `Atomics.wait()` and `Atomics.notify()` allow the consumer thread to sleep until the producer notifies it of new data, implementing true zero-CPU thread synchronization.
